name: Debian security tracker (security-tracker.debian.org)
tier_rationale: Established non-profit project (Software in the Public Interest) with public policies; distribution security team (A8 BR2). The module itself is offline (tier n/a, P355).
tier_reviewer: batch p3-G08-1 (council-1 A8 definitions; chair files P191/P354/P355)

reliability.justification: The distribution's own per-release fix status and fixed package versions: authoritative for Debian packages (not for upstream or derivatives).

security_tracker.title: Debian security tracker JSON export /tracker/data/json (package -> CVE -> per-release status and fixed version)

terms.quote: Debian security tracker data (public); P355 chair: 'Offline: tier n/a, terms open'.

security_tracker.notes: P355: opt-in dataset (~93 MB JSON, 15 MB gzip transfer), refreshed at most daily by `v3lum data update debian_security_tracker`, streamed (never json.load'ed whole) into a local SQLite index; no per-query network call.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G08-1 (P355). Tracker pages (/tracker/CVE-...) are links only.
